def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    from collections import deque
    from math import gcd

    n = len(a)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, value in enumerate(a):
        prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + value

    hull = deque()
    best_p, best_q = 0, 1

    for end in range(k, n + 1):
        new = end - k

        while len(hull) >= 2:
            x, y = hull[-2], hull[-1]
            if (prefix[y] - prefix[x]) * (new - y) < (
                prefix[new] - prefix[y]
            ) * (y - x):
                break
            hull.pop()
        hull.append(new)

        while len(hull) >= 2:
            x, y = hull[0], hull[1]
            if (prefix[end] - prefix[x]) * (end - y) > (
                prefix[end] - prefix[y]
            ) * (end - x):
                break
            hull.popleft()

        start = hull[0]
        p, q = prefix[end] - prefix[start], end - start
        if p * best_q > best_p * q:
            best_p, best_q = p, q

    divisor = gcd(best_p, best_q)
    return [best_p // divisor, best_q // divisor]
